CustomMetadata.label: AI connects as a dedicated user

values.value: Never connect AI (an agent, MCP server or integration) as a System Administrator: it would see and change everything. Create a separate integration user per AI connection, using the free Salesforce Integration user licence where possible, and give it only the permission sets its use case needs.
The AI user is active, not on an administrator profile, not your own account, and is a dedicated integration user (Salesforce Integration licence, or an integration/agent profile).
Checks the user this AI connects as: it should be a dedicated, active integration user, not a System Administrator and not someone's everyday account.
